text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Umur Persaraan Minimum

(Pengecualian) 2018.

Pengecualian

2. Menteri mengecualikan Pembinaan BLT Sdn. Bhd. dengan nombor

pendaftaran 704498-D daripada semua peruntukan Akta berkenaan dengan orang

yang dinamakan dalam Jadual yang diambil kerja untuk suatu kontrak perkhidmatan

bertempoh tetap, termasuk apa-apa pelanjutan, yang melebihi enam puluh bulan

bagi jawatan Pengurus Besar Kanan.

JADUAL

1. Nor Khairiah binti Abdul Halim

2. Noor Azman bin Embi

Dibuat 24 Julai 2018

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/5/2; PN(PU2)722/IV]

M. KULA SEGARAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

MINIMUM RETIREMENT AGE ACT 2012

MINIMUM RETIREMENT AGE (EXEMPTION) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 18 of the

Minimum Retirement Age Act 2012 [Act 753], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Minimum Retirement Age (Exemption)

Order 2018.

Exemption

2. The Minister exempts Pembinaan BLT Sdn. Bhd. with the registration

number 704498-D from all provisions of the Act in respect of the persons named in the

Schedule who are employed on a fixed term contract of service, inclusive of any

extension, of more than sixty months for the position as Senior General Manager.

SCHEDULE

1. Nor Khairiah binti Abdul Halim

2. Noor Azman bin Embi

Made 24 July 2018

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/5/2; PN(PU2)722/IV]

M. KULA SEGARAN

Minister of Human Resources
